sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption surveyed procurement officers and suppliers about corruption risks in public contracting.
sentences.support: online surveys with procurement officers and suppliers conducted by the Independent Commission Against Corruption

sentences.text: The surveys examined conflicts of interest, gifts, confidential information, procurement practices and barriers to reporting.
sentences.support: These risks are public officers failing to declare and manage conflicts of interest

sentences.text: The Commission reported that procurement officers generally viewed procurement integrity more positively than suppliers, but could underestimate corruption risks.
sentences.support: procurement officers have more positive views about the integrity of public sector procurement compared to suppliers.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that some suspicions went unreported and that suppliers did not sufficiently understand their public officer status and reporting obligations.
sentences.support: Suppliers who are contracted to public authorities are not sufficiently aware of their status as public officers

sentences.text: The Commission said recommendations would follow in a second report providing further analysis.
sentences.support: The Commission intends to publish a second report which will provide further analysis of corruption risks in public sector procurement and provide recommendations.

findings.quote: However, procurement officers may underestimate corruption risks in procurement.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. This report presents survey results and reserves recommendations for a later report; respondents’ perceptions are not treated as proven corruption.
